The solution isn’t another workaround. It’s infrastructure sovereignty. Owning the stack that processes payments, delivers products, and stores data. No middlemen. No subscriptions. No shutdowns. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

This is base-layer commerce infrastructure. Not a plugin. Not a SaaS tool. A complete stack of free and paid components that let you sell digital products directly to customers. The core problem is dependency. When you use Stripe, you’re renting their infrastructure. When they block your country, your business stops. Sovereign infrastructure flips this. You host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — both free, both global. You handle payments with NOWPayments, which verifies crypto transactions on-chain without KYC. You store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. You deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Every piece is modular. Every piece is yours. No platform can shut you down because no platform is required. This isn’t about avoiding fees. It’s about structural autonomy. Your customers pay in USDT on TRON — $0.03 transaction fee. They get the plugin instantly. You keep 99.5% of the sale. The system runs itself. You own it.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Start with hosting. GitHub Pages serves your storefront. Zero cost. Global CDN. Version control built-in. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script — both free tiers handle thousands of requests monthly. Payment processing is NOWPayments. Customer sends USDT on TRON. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. Webhook fires. Apps Script or Worker checks the payment ID. If valid, it generates a download link for your plugin. The link expires after one use. Order data goes to Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both offer public URLs. Both are free up to significant storage limits. Email receipts? SendGrid’s free tier. DNS configuration? Cloudflare’s free plan includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup. Every component is stateless. No servers to manage. No databases to patch. The stack self-heals. A customer in Accra pays. The system verifies. The plugin delivers. You sleep.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for creators in markets Stripe calls ‘high-risk.’ Nigeria. Ghana. Kenya. Pakistan. Bangladesh. Zimbabwe. Places where financial infrastructure is either broken or blocked. Your customers are designers buying your Figma templates. Developers buying your code snippets. Small businesses buying your WordPress plugins. They need your product. They have the money. But the payment processors won’t let them give it to you. Sovereign infrastructure solves this. It’s not a hack. It’s permanent architecture. You’re not begging Stripe to let you in. You’re building a system that doesn’t need their permission. Your customers pay in crypto because it’s the only currency that crosses borders without gatekeepers. You deliver the product instantly because the system is automated. You keep the data because you own the storage. This is for creators who choose ownership over dependency. Who build for markets others ignore. Who refuse to be locked out.
Sovereign infrastructure means no platform can shut you down.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both free. Both global. Both serve static sites. Backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers use JavaScript. Apps Script uses JavaScript-like syntax. Both handle logic. Both scale to thousands of requests. Payments: NOWPayments. 300+ cryptocurrencies. 0.5% fee. No KYC. Automatic webhooks. Storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Supabase is PostgreSQL. Sheets is familiar. Both store order data. File Delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both offer public URLs. Both are free up to significant limits. Email: SendGrid’s free tier sends 100 emails/day. DNS: Cloudflare’s free plan includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup. Each component is independent. Each does one job well. Together, they form a stack that sells plugins without payment processors. Without platforms. Without gatekeepers. The system runs itself. You focus on building plugins. Not fighting gatekeepers. Not begging for access. This is infrastructure sovereignty. Not a workaround. A permanent solution. Built for creators who refuse to be locked out. Who choose ownership. Who build for markets others ignore. Deploy today. Own tomorrow.

1. Choose your stack: Stack 01 (GitHub Pages + Apps Script) or Stack 02 (Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase). 2. Set up NOWPayments account. Enable USDT on TRON for low fees. 3. Deploy your storefront using the provided templates. 4. Load your plugin into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Configure backend logic to verify payments and generate download links. 6. Test the entire flow: payment, verification, delivery. 7. Set up SendGrid for email receipts. 8. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC using Cloudflare’s free DNS. 9. Launch your storefront. Share the link with your audience. 10. Monitor transactions in Supabase or Google Sheets.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’ve never coded before?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and step-by-step guides. No coding required. Deploy in 48 hours.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended for low fees: USDT on TRON, BSC, or Solana. Under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to manage servers?
No. The stack is stateless. Hosting is on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend runs on Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script. No servers to manage.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, the webhook won’t fire. The system will retry. You can also manually verify payments using the dashboard.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. This stack is designed for digital products — plugins, templates, ebooks, etc. Physical products require shipping integration, which is a separate architecture.
